title: Italy: city coverage gap (Milano, Veneto, Trentino-Alto Adige, Emilia-Romagna, Genova, Puglia)
description: Coverage-gap pass (2026-10-13) over Italian cities and regions not yet researched: Lombardia, Veneto, Trentino-Alto Adige, Emilia-Romagna, Toscana, Liguria, Lazio, Puglia and Piemonte. Leads from OSM (Overpass) and infoboulder.com; every candidate checked on its own site.
